entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add experimental gladstone APIs for accessing Roslyn solutions #85236
  • Consider making IDE0044 (Make field readonly) precondition more strict/accurate #85223

Closed

  • Null resilient props should not get nullable initial state in constructors #77991
    18.11
  • Razor source generator emits corrupted output for unchanged pages after the compiler server compiles the project with errors; persists until VBCSCompiler restarts #85196
  • Classic Razor compilation fails for mixed .cshtml and .razor projects #85132
  • Is this a bug that lambda discards aren't highlighted as keyword? #51553
    Backlog
  • IntelliSense shows CS8121 error on switch expression matching union type even it compiles #85224
  • [AI artifact audit] Weekly AI artifact hygiene audit: stale Roslyn guidance links #85197

PullRequests

Created

  • Add an instruction to link the plan/session in the PR #85235
  • Add on-demand project loading #85234
    VSCode
  • Make the ProjectData.Tasks package packable and include the targets file #85232
  • Restore the built-in VS SDK .pkgdef generation and migrate to it #85231
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Avoid unnecessary argument-builder work in generic type substitution #85230
  • Try violating a IDE0055 #85229
  • Update to .NET 11 RC1 #85228
  • Consolidate roslyn options to build with analyzers #85227
  • Reduce source file metadata I/O #85226
  • Avoid cache misses due to cancellation in deprioritized analyzer cache #85222

Merged

  • Show progress during long code reviews #85233
    Next
  • Make RoslynTelemetry instance-based with an ambient Current #85151
    VSCode, Next
  • Use non-null initial state for null-resilient properties in constructors #84991
    Next
  • Add on-demand project loading #84591
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Reduce decl/impl split fallbacks: split header-directive and @inject components #85069
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Honor inherited AssetPath attributes on component parameters #85171
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Make Razor tag helper resolution safe for concurrent mixed inputs #85167
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Let F# take part in the Navigate To search that runs while the solution loads #85213
    Area-IDE, Community, Next
  • Let F# create a workspace project context without blocking the main thread #85219
    Area-IDE, Community, Next

Updated

  • Add empty result to LSP request telemetry #85082
    VSCode
  • Create per-server daemon telemetry sessions #85155
    VSCode
  • Track per-project load completion in LanguageServerProjectLoader #85107
    VSCode
  • Use locally built CodeAnalysis testing libraries #85215
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Handle COM extension-block indexers in compound assignments #85212
  • Implement type parameter inference from constraints #84655
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Type Inference from Constraints
  • Forward DOTNET_ROOT and DOTNET_HOST_PATH to BuildHost #85195
    VSCode
  • Disallow ignored directives in disabled regions #85206
    Area-Compilers
  • Simplify partial modifier lookahead naming #85183
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Remove team specific ExternalAccess assemblies #85135
    Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Remove EditorConfigGenerator external access layer #85207
  • Fix simplifier's inconsistent removal of a type parameter cast #85201
    Bug, VSCode
  • Ignore embedded debug format for metadata-only emit #85028
  • Fix compiler server logging #85193
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix TextMate for JavaScript inside Razor #85198
    Area-Razor
